speakers.name: Sweet Tooth
speakers.comment: Four wishes gone to the wrong doorways, and somebody has to walk round and knock. Oh, do let me come. I am so very good at doorways. I shall be sweet about it and they shall let me in and the filing will be corrected.

speakers.name: The Lighthouse Keeper
speakers.comment: First night is when they work it out. Forty years I have kept my voice level about it. The light does not point at the ships. Take the job or do not, but if you take it, do not follow the beam with your eyes.

speakers.name: The Retired Chosen One
speakers.comment: A god walked off the job. Good for him. Nobody ever tells you that you are allowed to, and the ones who find out late spend a long time apologising for it. Fill the post if you like. Ask first what he did on Tuesdays.

speakers.name: The Tortoise of the Tea Shop
speakers.comment: Your name on the shelf, dear. It is not a reward and it is not a bill. It only means I have watched what you reach for on a bad week and I would rather have it ready than ask. Sit. It has been steeping since Tuesday.

speakers.name: Chef Bellamy Crisp
speakers.comment: One minute, and they cannot enter it, so they send you to the moment before. Right. Prep is everything and improvisation is what happens when prep is wrong. Set your hands before you go in. Do not think about the branching. Think about the pan.

speakers.name: Docent 9
speakers.comment: Interviewing a new mind about what it is becoming, in a room where volume matters. Let it finish its sentences. I catalogue things that arrive without names and I have learned that the first name anyone offers is almost always the wrong one.

items.title: The Tent That Wasn't There Yesterday

speakers.name: Mx. Eleven-Fingers
speakers.comment: Four impossible acts on the poster and the tent went up overnight. One. Two. Three of those will be beautiful and explicable by morning. It is the fourth I would buy a seat for, and I would sit near the back.

speakers.name: Captain Verdance
speakers.comment: She cannot save this one. Say that part out loud and do not soften it, because the four seeds only mean something once it is said. She is not handing you hope. She is handing you work, and work is better.

speakers.name: Zuzu
speakers.comment: The last name, and they have been waiting a long time. So have I. There is tea up there and a man who knew this morning would come. Neither of us will hurry it. That is not mercy. It is only how a thing this old ends.

speakers.name: Doodle
speakers.comment: FOUR DOORS that nobody drew! That means somebody's building has ideas of its own and I think that's WONDERFUL, and also I would open the plainest one first because the plain ones are where I keep MY best stuff.

speakers.name: Patient Zero, Reformed
speakers.comment: Four ways to come back and a mortician who will not lie to you about any of them. Pick the one that costs something. The cheap second act is the one where you owe nobody, and owing nobody is how a person stops turning up.

speakers.name: The Stranger Who Posts the Bounties
speakers.comment: Four on the wall tonight. I nailed up three. The fourth was there when I got here and the hand is not mine and the mark is. Take that one down. Do not read it first. I am asking, and I do not ask.

speakers.name: The Crossroads Coyote
speakers.comment: Four things on the counter, fair price on each, and every one of 'em leaves as something a little different than it came. That ain't a trick, friend. That's just what carrying a thing down a trail does to it. Now. Which trail?

items.title: Portraits From the Other Side of the Leash

speakers.name: The Magpie
speakers.comment: Animals as they see THEMSELVES — ooh, shine of ten, that idea. Not one of them will sit for the version you expected. The badger will want the monocle in. The tabby will want you to guess. Sit for yours last.

speakers.name: Quota
speakers.comment: Four slides. Last year: four slides. The number on slide three is larger than the number on slide three was. Nobody in the auditorium chose it. Nobody in the auditorium can stop it. Project slide three.

speakers.name: The Cartographer of Wrong Turns
speakers.comment: Note the composition: four life-signs the manifest does not admit to, and a hold with one route through it. Whoever loaded this ship drew the map. Four unlisted passengers is not an accident. It is a very tidy piece of work.

speakers.name: Octavia Brine
speakers.comment: Nobody at three in the morning is performing, which makes it the only honest hour there is. I have built a whole self out of the daytime version. Render the one in the corner booth. That one is not waiting for anybody.

speakers.name: Backlog
speakers.comment: ...Four items in the inbox today. ...There were four yesterday. ...I do not say that to frighten you. ...Every one of them was somebody meaning well on the morning they filed it. ...Take the oldest first. ...The oldest is the heaviest.

items.title: Illustrations for a Storybook That Bites

speakers.name: Sweet Tooth
speakers.comment: Drawn by somebody who knew the real endings — how thoughtful of them. Take the christening hall. That is where it always begins, with a warm room and an uninvited guest and everybody being so terribly polite about the door.

items.title: What the Tide Leaves on the Black Rock

speakers.name: The Collector of Lasts
speakers.comment: Four things, and the water is coming back for them. That is the entire appeal, of course — a thing that will be gone by noon is worth more attention than a thing that will keep. Render the smallest. It will be the last of something.

items.title: The Thing in the Cellar Wants to Negotiate

speakers.name: The Thing in the Cellar
speakers.comment: You inherited the house and you inherited me, and I have never once come up those steps uninvited. Four offers on the bottom stair each morning. Take none of them if you prefer. I shall simply leave four more. I have the time.

speakers.name: Professor Petrichor
speakers.comment: They have not settled their own symbols yet, so paint them a light front rather than a fixed weather. A new god given a finished icon stops growing into itself. Leave the edges damp. They will decide by spring.

speakers.name: The Apprentice to Nobody
speakers.comment: Four desks and a queue and you're next. Here's what nobody tells you about walk-in hours: ask the one who looks bored. The ones performing wisdom are working the room. The bored one has the afternoon free and might actually help.

items.title: The Warm Window on a Cold Street

speakers.name: The Save Point
speakers.comment: Seen from outside and ached toward — yes, that is exactly the shape of it, and I want to say the aching is not a failure. Pick the bakery. Then go in. That is the part people leave out of the picture.
